# sofascore_scraper.store.ChangeRow
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/changes.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChangeRow:
    seq: int
    ts: int
    event_id: int
    sport: Optional[str]
    tournament_id: Optional[int]
    status_regressed: bool
    fields: Tuple[str, ...]
    row: Mapping[str, Any]
    segment: str
